target.format: APLOSE results CSV as inspected through OSEkit

entries.detail: Talk2Nature recording IDs and declared checksum are not APLOSE project, filename, or annotation IDs.
Relative WAV offsets do not establish a wall-clock start time or timezone.
annotation.v1 has no frequency-bound fields; no values may be inferred.
Talk2Nature interval events cannot losslessly encode APLOSE POINT, WEAK, or frequency-box geometry.
Preserve source labels as strings; no label-to-kind, context, or meaning mapping is approved.
Independent observer files remain separate; this schema does not store per-event adjudication history.
A free-text comment or signal descriptor is not automatically an independently observed context.

decision: Do not create an APLOSE file or converter from this report. A named research group, exact target version, approved codebook, rights review, and synthetic reopen test are prerequisites.
